purpose: Compare the plotting semantics of the reference Q1 figure (fig_q1_step_sweep step0) against the final Test/Holdout prediction figures, to answer whether 'seed-mean lead-1' equals 'step0' and whether the curves are fixed-origin full-horizon forecasts or rolling-origin fixed-lead concatenations.

reference_figure.step0_meaning: keep only forecast step == 0 (lead_weeks == 1, i.e. 1-week-ahead) from every test window, then groupby(abs_week).mean()
reference_figure.lead_mapping: step h == (h+1)-week ahead, so step 0 == lead-1 == 1-week-ahead
reference_figure.line_style: ground truth solid black; prediction dashed red
reference_figure.multiplicity_resolution: at fixed step each target week is predicted by exactly ONE origin; groupby mean resolves the remaining per-seed repetition

final_test_figures.aggregation: load_seed_mean_curves (seed-mean over seeds 42..51) then lead1_curve (filter lead_weeks == 1)
final_test_figures.line_style: ground truth solid blue (#1f77b4); prediction dashed red (#d62728); observed/predicted peak markers
final_test_figures.scope: Test target weeks the horizon reaches at lead-1: abs_week [820, 1025-L]
final_test_figures.multiplicity_resolution: test_predictions.csv carries 7 variables per (target_date, lead); filtered to variable_index == 4 (ILITOTAL); seed-mean over 10 seeds; at fixed lead each target week has exactly one forecast origin

comparison.explanation: step 0 in fixed_step aggregation IS lead_weeks 1 (1-week-ahead); the final figures' 'seed-mean lead-1' filter is the same slice. Both then average over seeds only (a fixed lead leaves exactly one origin per target week).

Both are ROLLING-ORIGIN fixed-lead (lead-1) concatenations: each plotted point is the 1-week-ahead forecast from a distinct origin (origin = target_week - 104), NOT a single origin's full-L-step trajectory.
Both use calendar week (week_start_date) on x; the final figures resolve it via the authoritative cdc_calendar MMWR mapping (fixes the old ~19-week drift).
Both plot ILITOTAL in physical (original) units, not z-space.

differences.data_source: reference reads data/predictions_miflu_L{L}_paper_protocol.csv (earlier HPC paper-protocol export); final reads results/v3_clean/test_eval/results/*/predictions/test_predictions.csv (frozen one-time Test runs)
differences.models: reference is MIFlu-only; final covers nlinear / gpt2_miflu / seasonal_naive
differences.color_scheme: reference black/red; final blue/red with peak markers
differences.semantic_effect: none — data source and color differ, but the plotted quantity (lead-1 seed-mean ILITOTAL over test target weeks) is identical

conclusion: Figure semantics are CONSISTENT. 'seed-mean lead-1' equals step0; both are rolling-origin lead-1 concatenations, not single-origin full-horizon forecasts. No figure regeneration required for semantic correctness.
